server-gc.log.scope: entire preserved service log, including startup and JMH-idle period before system resource sampling

gc.log.scope: system corpus client only; excludes JMH fork GC profiler

limits: The sampler covers the service process during the system corpus; PostgreSQL, client and JMH fork memory are excluded.
Sampled RSS and kernel high-water include native/JIT/thread memory, not only Java heap.
CPU includes worker/JIT/GC/service tasks and is not attributed solely to solver work.
Server GC log scope exceeds resource sampling scope; pause fraction of sampled time is not reported.
No resource or request p95/p99 is inferred from three solver outcomes.
